solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Provoke George first, then complain

indicators.note: first says the George letter goes at the front, before the provoke synonym

parts.note: G is a standard abbreviation for the name George
to provoke is to rouse or stir up

explanation.surface: Someone stirs up George to start with, then has a moan about it.
explanation.definitionFit: To grouse is an informal synonym for grumble or gripe.

clue.text: Armour pinched by Grant

parts.note: a pinched face is gaunt, thin and haggard
to grant is to allow, to let

explanation.surface: Some armour has been stolen by a man named Grant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pinched' reads as stolen and 'Grant' as a name; they are gaunt and let.
explanation.definitionFit: A gauntlet is the armoured glove in a suit of armour.

clue.text: Alumnus engages retainer; on guard!

indicators.note: engages says the old boy takes on the retainer, which follows him

parts.note: OB, old boy, is a former pupil
a retainer is a servant of a household

explanation.surface: A former pupil hires a servant and tells them to stay alert.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone on guard is watchful and alert, quick to notice.

clue.text: Notice outsized bag

definitions.meaning: being given notice is dismissal from a job, as in getting fired
a large coarse bag, as for potatoes

explanation.surface: Spot a huge holdall.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both dismissal from work and a big coarse carrying bag.

clue.text: Cool guy with healthy drink

definitions.meaning: a suave, slick, charming man, a smooth operator
a blended drink of fruit, yoghurt or vegetables

explanation.surface: A trendy fellow sipping something wholesome.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a suave charmer and a thick blended fruit beverage.

clue.text: The art of delivery omits lines for its exponent

indicators.note: omits means the lines letters are left out

parts.note: midwifery is the skill of delivering babies
RY, railway, is the usual abbreviation for lines

explanation.surface: A description of speech-giving that skips some lines, and the person who practises it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'delivery' suggests speeches or post; it is childbirth. 'its exponent' is the practitioner of that art.
explanation.definitionFit: The practitioner of midwifery is the nurse who assists at births.

clue.text: Ask for more to service past debt

parts.note: over means finished, past
a charge is a debt or amount billed

explanation.surface: Requesting extra money to pay off old borrowings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to service' belongs to the definition: billing too much for a service.
explanation.definitionFit: To overcharge is to bill someone more than a fair price.

clue.text: Fuss about surprised expressions on the rise

indicators.note: in a down answer, on the rise means read upwards, so these letters go backwards

parts.note: ah and ooh are exclamations of surprise

explanation.surface: A commotion over gasps of astonishment that keep growing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the rise' turns AH and OOH round.
explanation.definitionFit: A hoo-ha is a commotion or noisy fuss over something.

clue.text: Dismisses outcasts who've blown their top

indicators.note: losing the top means the opening letter of the outcasts word is dropped

parts.note: rejects are people cast aside

explanation.surface: Throwing out angry pariahs who have lost their temper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blown their top' looks like losing one's temper; it removes the R.
explanation.definitionFit: To eject someone is to throw them out or dismiss them.

clue.text: Ruffled horse takes race after one disqualified

indicators.note: takes means the horse word holds the next letter inside it

parts.note: a filly is a young female horse

indicators.note: disqualified means the one synonym is struck out of race

parts.note: taken as written, before ace is removed
an ace is a one in cards or dice

explanation.surface: A rattled racehorse lines up after a rival is disqualified.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disqualified' strips ACE, a one, from RACE to leave R.
explanation.definitionFit: Frilly clothing is decorated with frills or ruffles.

clue.text: Censured university about type of loan

indicators.note: about here means moved around, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A university was censured over some kind of lending arrangement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' looks like it means concerning, but it is the signal to rearrange the first word; the university letter is then placed at the front.
explanation.definitionFit: A loan given without collateral, backed by no security, is described this way.

clue.text: Run away from Rod, going west, then east

indicators.note: in an across answer, going west means read right to left, so the rod synonym is turned around

parts.note: a pole is a rod or staff
E is the compass abbreviation for east

explanation.surface: Escaping from a man called Rod, heading west and then east.
explanation.definitionFit: To elope is to run off secretly, especially to marry.

clue.text: Time to take part in Mastermind?

indicators.note: taking part of the word Mastermind means some of its letters are lifted out from inside it

explanation.surface: Is it time to be a contestant on Mastermind, the British TV quiz show?
explanation.walkthrough: Mastermind is a long-running BBC quiz show; the letters sit in the middle of its name.
explanation.definitionFit: A school term or a term of office is a fixed period of time.

clue.text: Ordinary song sung in church

parts.note: plain means simple or ordinary
a chant is a simple song or melody

explanation.surface: An unadorned piece of music performed during a church service.
explanation.definitionFit: Plainsong, unaccompanied medieval church music sung in unison, is also called by this name.

clue.text: Excited by risqué adult items

indicators.note: risqué means improper, so the letters are rearranged out of decent order

explanation.surface: Aroused by some racy adult merchandise.
explanation.definitionFit: Stimulated means roused or excited into activity.

clue.text: On the dot of ten, turn in East Anglian city

indicators.note: in says the ten and turn letters go inside the city name

parts.note: Ely is a cathedral city in Cambridgeshire, East Anglia
X is the Roman numeral for ten
a turn is a performer's act on stage

explanation.surface: Precisely at ten o'clock a performance happens in an English cathedral city.
explanation.walkthrough: East Anglia is the eastern bulge of England; ELY is the crossword's favourite city there.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done on the dot is done precisely, at the exact moment.

clue.text: Empower the Three Degrees to pick up seaman and leave first

indicators.note: to pick up means to take on board, so the other letters go inside

parts.note: east-north-east is a bearing written with three compass letters; the clue also nods to the pop group The Three Degrees
AB, able-bodied seaman, is a sailor

indicators.note: first says only the opening letter of leave is used

explanation.surface: Telling a soul trio to collect a sailor and then depart.
explanation.walkthrough: The Three Degrees were an American vocal group; here ENE (east-north-east) is three compass points, though strictly they are points rather than degrees.
explanation.definitionFit: To enable someone is to give them the power or means to act.

clue.text: The Queen's favourite cheese

definitions.meaning: Robert Dudley, Earl of this title, was Elizabeth I's favourite courtier
Red ___ is an orange English hard cheese

explanation.surface: Her Majesty's preferred cheese.
explanation.definitionFit: The name is both Elizabeth I's favoured earl and a crumbly orange English cheese.

clue.text: Gilbert & Sullivan in (for example) torment will crack easily

parts.note: EG is the abbreviation for exempli gratia, for example
G and S are the initials of the comic opera partners
hell is torment

explanation.surface: A performance of Gilbert and Sullivan operetta becomes torture for someone fragile.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is only a link here: placing the operetta initials inside the example abbreviation would scramble the order, so the three pieces simply run side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: An egg's shell is proverbially fragile and breaks at a touch.

clue.text: Alpha male in charge of something minute

parts.note: A is the letter Alpha stands for in the NATO alphabet
a tom is a male cat

explanation.surface: A dominant man is put in charge of some tiny matter.
explanation.definitionFit: Something on the scale of atoms is extremely small, tiny.

clue.text: Opportunity for Liberal in part of church

parts.note: a chance is an opportunity
L is the abbreviation for Liberal, the political party

explanation.surface: A Liberal candidate gets a chance in a section of the church.
explanation.definitionFit: The chancel is the area round the altar, reserved for clergy and choir.

clue.text: Having a laugh after student's avoided going to concerts

indicators.note: avoided means the student letter is kept out of the laugh word

parts.note: giggling is having a little laugh
L, for learner, is the usual crossword student

explanation.surface: Laughing after skipping lessons to go and see live bands.
explanation.walkthrough: L is a learner driver's plate letter in Britain, hence student.
explanation.definitionFit: Gigging is attending or playing live music shows.

clue.text: Capacity for bitterness nothing new

parts.note: gall is bitterness or rancour
O, the round letter, stands for zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Someone has a capacity for resentment, and nothing has changed.
explanation.definitionFit: A gallon is a unit of volume, a measure of liquid capacity.

clue.text: A US hit remixed in break

indicators.note: a remix rearranges a track, so the letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: An American chart hit gets reworked during an interval.
explanation.definitionFit: A hiatus is a pause or gap in continuity.

clue.text: Blue van Ali discovered was extremely useful

indicators.note: discovered is read as un-covered, its letters exposed and rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone called Ali found a blue van that proved a godsend.
explanation.definitionFit: Invaluable means so useful its worth cannot be measured, not worthless.

clue.text: Broadway hasn't a place to meet

indicators.note: hasn't means the a is missing from the street word

parts.note: Broadway is a famous New York avenue

explanation.surface: Broadway lacks anywhere for people to get together.
explanation.definitionFit: A venue is the location where an event or meeting happens.

clue.text: Appreciates AS-levels are not odd

indicators.note: taking the letters that are not in odd positions means keeping the even ones, second, fourth and so on

explanation.surface: Someone values AS-level exams that aren't strange.
explanation.walkthrough: AS-levels are British school exams taken around age 17.
explanation.definitionFit: To see a point is to understand or appreciate it.

clue.text: How undergraduates loved Amy's first Hawaiian dance

indicators.note: first takes the opening letter of each of the four words before it

explanation.surface: Students adored the first island dance a woman named Amy performed.
explanation.definitionFit: The hula is the traditional swaying dance of Hawaii.

clue.text: The principle of considerate networking

indicators.note: of here means taken from, so the letters come from inside the phrase considerate networking

explanation.surface: Being thoughtful when making business contacts is a guiding rule.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenet is a doctrine or belief held as true.

clue.text: Giddy girl eats ravioli starter and cake

indicators.note: eats means the flirt takes the letter in, so it goes inside

parts.note: a coquette is a flirtatious, frivolous young woman

indicators.note: starter means just the first letter of ravioli

explanation.surface: A flighty young woman orders pasta to start and then a dessert.
explanation.definitionFit: A croquette is a small fried roll or patty, often called a fishcake or potato cake.

clue.text: Consistently set daily puzzle

indicators.note: to puzzle letters is to jumble them up, so these are rearranged

explanation.surface: A puzzle is reliably set every day.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something steadily means doing it at an even, regular pace.

clue.text: Buddy admitted some of tropical task force

indicators.note: admitted means let in, so the other letters go inside

parts.note: a pal is a buddy or friend

indicators.note: some of means only the opening part of the word tropical is used, the rest dropped

explanation.surface: A friend joined a group working in the tropics.
explanation.definitionFit: A patrol is a small detachment sent out on a mission.
